offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Token-based pricing: Prototype Development, 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment, 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens). Every search request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10000 tokens.
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；单次搜索从 10,000 tokens 起
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON search mode returns five entries.
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；免费/付费密钥 100 RPM，高级密钥 1000 RPM。
